definitions.gloss: serious illness, major disease, grave sickness
definitions.explanation: A severe or life-threatening illness. Implies that the condition is or was significant enough to seriously impact one's life, requiring extended treatment or hospitalization.

examples.japanese: {大病|たいびょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{患|わずら}った→患う：27883_wazurau⟧。
{大病|たいびょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ありがたみ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: After going through a serious illness, I understood the value of good health.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{若|わか}い{頃|ころ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{大病|たいびょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{無事|ぶじ}→無事：01602_buji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}して→回復する：21330_kaifukusuru⟧⟦{長生|ながい}き→長生き：03128_nagaiki⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather experienced a serious illness when he was young, but he recovered safely and lived a long life.

notes:
{大病|たいびょう} refers to an illness serious enough to be life-altering or life-threatening.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大病|たいびょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{患|わずら}う→患う：27883_wazurau⟧: to suffer from a serious illness
- {大病|たいびょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to have a serious illness
- {大病|たいびょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to experience a serious illness
- {大病|たいびょう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}する→回復する：21330_kaifukusuru⟧: to recover from a serious illness

USAGE:
Often used when reflecting on a past illness or discussing life-changing health events. The phrase {大病|たいびょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ ("I've never had a serious illness") is a common way to express being in good health throughout one's life.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧: illness, sickness (general)
- ⟦{重病|じゅうびょう}→重病：25277_juubyou⟧: serious/critical illness (more medical, often current)
- {大病|たいびょう}: serious illness (often reflective, life-changing event)
